items.statement: GET on /redfish/v1/Systems/<str>/ResetActionInfo/ requires getActionInfo privilege and dispatches to handleSystemCollectionResetActionGet.
The GET handler validates the Redfish route and system name, initializes ActionInfo response metadata, then resolves the system index before requesting allowed host transitions.
A missing AllowedHostTransitions property adds the five fallback ResetTypes to the response values.
A D-Bus error other than the recognized missing-property errors emits InternalError and returns before Parameters are published.
The missing-property path builds AllowableValues from the three universal ResetTypes plus the five fallback ResetTypes.
After a successful property read, ResetType AllowableValues contains the universal ForceOff, PowerCycle, and Nmi defaults plus the Redfish ResetTypes mapped from each reported D-Bus host transition.
afterGetAllowedHostTransitions receives the transition vector, seeds three universal ResetTypes, and either extends fallback values or returns on a D-Bus error.
getAllowedHostTransitions reads AllowedHostTransitions from the indexed host-state service and object on xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host and binds the result callback to the shared response.
The asynchronous getProperty callback retains asyncResp through bind_front and later builds the ActionInfo Parameters response from the D-Bus result.
An invalid_argument property-read error produces an HTTP internal-server-error response.
A bad_request_descriptor property-read error produces the complete eight-value fallback ResetType list.
The ResetActionInfo HEAD route requires headActionInfo privilege and dispatches to its HEAD handler.
items.description: The Redfish ResetActionInfo resource binds HEAD to its dedicated handler under headActionInfo privilege.
